about_the_game:
In this elementary school, hell isn’t a metaphor.
It’s a reward.

This is a 2D free-movement survival horror game.
Set on the final day before winter exams, three elementary school students—ranked at the very bottom of their class—find themselves trapped inside a school warped by cursed rumors and something far more sinister.

You will play as all three children, switching between them as they explore, hide, and cooperate within a maze-like, collapsing school building—desperately searching for a way out of this “test” that has nothing to do with grades.

Something is writing names on the blackboard.
It says: trade your fear, and you can be smart.
You can be number one.
But you must let it in first.

No adults. No explanations.
Only classrooms, exam papers, a dying flashlight—
and your friends, fading one by one.

Survive long enough to uncover the truth.
If you dare.

content_descriptors.notes: It contains Fantasy / Mild Violence,  Crime, Horror and General Mature Content
